description: This file defines inline functions related to I/O remapping for the RTL838X platform in the Linux kernel, including checks for internal register ranges and simplified iomap/unmap functions.

methods.name: int is_rtl838x_internal_registers(phys_addr_t offset)
methods.description: Determines if a given physical address offset falls within internal register ranges for the RTL838X platform.

methods.name: void __iomem * plat_ioremap(phys_addr_t offset,unsigned long size,unsigned long flags)
methods.description: Returns a pointer for I/O memory mapping based on address; simplified version skipping actual remapping.

methods.name: int plat_iounmap(const volatile void __iomem * addr)
methods.description: Checks if an I/O memory address belongs to internal registers; in this simplified version, serves as unmap.

ctags.name: plat_ioremap
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void __iomem *plat_ioremap(phys_addr_t offset, unsigned long size,$/
